title: THE TRIPWIRE MINE KEEPS A KEY WITH A PLATE
why: From the review of the Tripwire Mine build, his answer 32 (on the belt like a grenade). Carrying an armour plate filled all nine belt keys (four gun keys, three grenades, Medical and the plate), so a Tripwire Mine got no cell at all: Q skipped it and a controller player, who can only throw from a belt cell, could not throw it until the plate was used. Now a mine with no cell takes the highest empty gun key (key 4, then key 3), the way a Stim already does, and it stays on that key for the rest of the raid, so using the plate later does not move it.
now: A Tripwire Mine always has a belt key, on key 4 or 3 when an armour plate fills key 9, and the controller can select and throw it.
